nodes.label: Monorepo Architecture (pnpm workspace + Turbo)
nodes.rationale: Centralized dependency management with pnpm workspaces, Turbo for optimized task orchestration and caching, Biome for unified linting/formatting, Lefthook for git hooks; chosen to eliminate duplicate dependencies and unify code style across backend and frontend packages

nodes.label: Backend Layered Architecture (Models -> Services -> Controllers -> Plugins)
nodes.rationale: Fastify backend with controllers and plugins auto-loaded from their directories; authorization is centralized in the service layer so controllers never access models directly
nodes.norm_label: backend layered architecture (models -> services -> controllers -> plugins)

nodes.label: BaseAuthorizedService Authorization Pattern
nodes.rationale: Project-scoped access control built into the base service class via ensureAccessToProject, ensureAccessToEnvironment and ensureAccessToDeployment, so every business operation carries authorization by construction

nodes.label: Multi-provider Authentication (Local JWT, Auth0, Google OAuth, Azure EntraID, API keys)
nodes.norm_label: multi-provider authentication (local jwt, auth0, google oauth, azure entraid, api keys)

nodes.label: Backend Controller Pattern (auto-loaded Fastify routes)
nodes.rationale: Controllers are auto-loaded, access the user via request.databaseUser and delegate all database operations to services; direct model access in controllers is forbidden

nodes.label: ApiStatusHandler Data Fetching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Page components always wrap content in ApiStatusHandler with React Query queries so loading and error states are handled uniformly across the frontend

nodes.label: Dependabot Weekly npm Updates (frontend and backend)
nodes.norm_label: dependabot weekly npm updates (frontend and backend)

nodes.label: Deploy to Server Workflow
nodes.rationale: On push to the development branch, builds the Docker image then deploys via SSH by running OpenTofu (tofu init/apply) on the target server

nodes.label: Docker Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: Reusable workflow (workflow_call, plus push to main/tags) that downloads backend-build and frontend-build artifacts from the monorepo build and pushes the lory1990/mfe-orchestrator image to Docker Hub, tagging with the git tag when present

nodes.label: Monorepo Build & Test Workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds all packages with pnpm + Turbo cache and uploads backend/dist and frontend/dist as the backend-build and frontend-build artifacts consumed by the Docker build

nodes.label: E2E Tests Workflow (Playwright)
nodes.rationale: Runs Playwright Chromium E2E tests against https://console-dev.mfe-orchestrator.dev on manual dispatch, push to the e2e branch, or weekly cron (Monday 6:00 UTC); uploads playwright-report and test-results artifacts for 30 days

nodes.label: Conventional Commits Specification
nodes.rationale: Adopted to automatically generate changelogs, determine semantic version bumps (feat=MINOR, fix=PATCH, BREAKING CHANGE=MAJOR), communicate changes clearly and trigger build/publish processes; enforced by commitlint via git hooks

nodes.label: Microfrontend Orchestrator (product)
nodes.rationale: Centralized service with JSON-based configuration describing microfrontends and their versions, so microfrontends can be deployed and managed independently across environments (DEV, UAT, PROD) without a complete frontend rebuild; planned integrations include Module Federation and micro-lc

nodes.label: Telemetry Payload (aggregate counters only)
nodes.rationale: Exactly eight fields: installationId, version, nodeVersion, projects, microfrontends, environments, users, deploymentsLastWeek. Counts only, never names, emails, URLs, hostnames, IPs, secrets or content; the code has no way to send anything else

nodes.label: Telemetry Installation ID
nodes.rationale: Random crypto.randomUUID() generated on first ping and stored in the user's own database (configurations collection, TELEMETRY_INSTALLATION_ID); derived from nothing about the host, deletable at will; exists only to avoid counting one installation as thousands

nodes.label: Playwright E2E Test Suite
nodes.rationale: Chromium-only Playwright tests with base URL http://localhost:5173 overridable via BASE_URL; in CI tests retry up to 2 times and run sequentially, and the dev server is not reused

nodes.label: Frontend HTML Entry Point (Microfrontend Orchestrator Hub)
nodes.rationale: Loads /config.js as a plain script before the module bundle so runtime configuration is available prior to app startup; hosted console lives at https://console.mfe-orchestrator.dev with full Open Graph and Twitter meta tags
nodes.norm_label: frontend html entry point (microfrontend orchestrator hub)

nodes.label: Lefthook Pre-commit Hooks (Biome check + typecheck)
nodes.rationale: Runs in parallel: Biome check --write on staged backend/frontend JS/TS files (auto-staging fixes) plus tsc --noEmit per package; conditional glob execution keeps hooks fast
